DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilq.qov.ph DILG OPINION No. 106 s. 2021 August 20, 2021 ATTY. VENUS C. VELASCO Sangguniang Panlungsod Secretary Pamahalaang Lungsod ng Cabuyao Lalawigan ng Laguna Dear Atty. Velasco: This has reference to your letter dated 01 July 2021 addressed to the Office of the President and referred to this Department by the Office of Deputy Executive Secretary for Legal Affairs, Office of the President, requesting our legal opinion on, we quote: "x x x whether the Sangguniang Panlungsod as the legislative unit of the local govemment unit (LGU), can require attendance/reply from the depattment heads/resource persons in committee hearings/letter inquiries for the purpose of obtaining relevant, timely and accurate information on projects and programs being implemented, to be implemented and already finished projects and programs in the LGU x x x" At the onset, please be informed that the issue you raised has already been settled in DILG Legal Opinion No. 22, series of 2009. To reiterate, we opined that in the exercise of legislative powers, the sanggunian has no compulsory process to require persons to appear before it. As a remedy, the sanggunian may invoke the duty of the City Mayor under Section 455 of Republic Act No. 7160 or the Local Govemment Code of 1991 to furnish the necessary information and data to the sanggunian by requiring the mayor or his duly authorized representative to be present in any session to present the information and data requested by the sanggunian. It must be stressed, however, if the person so required by the sanggunian is other than the mayor, the sanggunian should first secure the permission or approval of the mayor before any appearance is made before it in reverence to the administrative hierarchy in the city government. Attached is a copy of the aforesaid DILG Legal Opinion for ease of reference. "Matino, Mahusat at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, UTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY NGAN creta for Local Government : DILG OUSLG/MLVLLL-s-1-RALLD/clp/OUSLG/ao cc ATTY. RYAN ALVIN ACOSTA Deputy Executive Secretary for Legal Affairs Office of the President REGIONAL DIRECTOR ARIEL IGLESIA DILG Regional Office-CALABARZON Page 2 of 2
